{{Top|leg}}
'''Thrust dampers''' were a piece of machinery used on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. If the thrust dampers were disabled, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were forced to switch to walker mode to operate. One fighter attacked the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on board the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']]. Its thrust dampers were disabled after the Jedi reflected its laser blasts back at it using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Further deflected blasts destroyed the starfighter.

==Behind the scenes==
Thrust dampers appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]'' and were identified in the game's [[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].
